note: Dallas County MO says it has no zoning authority; its unincorporated land is not zoned by the county. Its GIS viewer (dallascountygis ArcGIS Online map) holds election, census and parcel-type layers but no zoning district layer. The largest city, Buffalo (county seat), zones under its own code, but no public zoning GIS service or district map was found; its website offers only ordinance PDFs and agendas. The integritygis host did not respond.
